::: {.content-band}
<p class="section-kicker">RESEARCH PROGRAM</p>

## Statistics for structured, high-dimensional science

My work connects modern statistical theory with challenges arising in genomics, microbiome studies, and other data-rich scientific settings.

::: {.research-grid}
::: {.research-card}
<span class="card-number">01</span>

### Multi-view data integration

Low-rank and structured methods that identify shared and view-specific variation across multiple data sources.

[Learn more →](research.qmd#multi-view-data-integration)
:::

::: {.research-card}
<span class="card-number">02</span>

### High-dimensional mediation

Selection and inference for mediation effects when the number of potential mediators is large and the outcome model is complex.

[Learn more →](research.qmd#high-dimensional-mediation-analysis)
:::

::: {.research-card}
<span class="card-number">03</span>

### Statistics for omics

Methods tailored to compositional, zero-inflated, confounded, and multi-omic measurements.

[Learn more →](research.qmd#statistical-methods-for-omics)
:::
:::
:::
